#endif

#define FOR(IN,N) for(int I = IN;I < N;++I)
#define FORR(END,N) for(int I = N-1;I >= END;--I)
#define foreach(arr) for(auto item : arr)

#define PB push_back
#define remove erase

#define sz(a) a.size();

#define MAX 10010

typedef long long i64;
typedef pair<int,int> pii;

string solve,s; int N;

	if(solve[0] == '.'){
		solve.erase(0,1);
		solve = "dot" + solve;
	}
	else if(solve[0] == '@'){
		solve.erase(0,1);
		solve = "at" + solve;
	}

	if(solve[solve.size() - 1] == '.'){
		solve.pop_back();
		solve += "dot";
	}
	else if(solve[solve.size() - 1] == '@'){
		solve.pop_back();
		solve += "at";
	}

}

{
	ios_base :: sync_with_stdio(0);
	cin.tie(0);

	cin >> s;

			if(s.substr(I,3) == "dot"){
				solve += ".";
				I+=2;
			}

				if(I + 2 <= N){

				solve += "@";
